title: Use Cases
subtitle: Pick a pattern for your screen
description: Common production shapes mapped to qortex-resource — from a tiny settings form to a catalog product editor.
content: Start here if you know the UI you need but not which APIs to wire. Each recipe links to a deeper guide.

sections.title: 1. Local-only form (no API yet)
sections.content: Prototype UI with initialData and a fake save. Great for Storybook and design iteration.

sections.title: 2. Edit existing entity (fetch + save)
sections.content: Classic admin detail page. Composite key + fetch/save closures.

sections.title: 3. Create new entity
sections.content: No fetch — seed empty defaults, save creates on the server. See Create vs Edit guide.

sections.title: 4. Nested product / CRM form
sections.content: Addresses, line items, variants — field arrays + Zod. See Product Form Example.

sections.title: 5. Settings page with optimistic UX
sections.content: Small payload, snappy toggles — optimistic save + toast on error.

sections.title: 6. List with inline row edit
sections.content: Collection + getResource(id) per row (React: useCollection). See Row Editing guide in resource-react.

sections.title: 7. Bridge existing query cache
sections.content: Keep qortex-query (or similar) as source of truth; resource owns the draft. See Sources.
